title: MT61130: Heat Treatment Technology
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Time-temperature parameters of a heat treatment process; classification of heat
treatment processes; heat treatment as applied to the products of steel-making
industry, machine building and automobile industry, tool making industry, etc.;
heat treatment defects and their rectification, modernisation of heat treatment
processes for near net shape applications and surface treatments; energy
efficiency in heat treatments; furnace atmospoheres and their production,
heating and cooling media and their characteristics; calculations on heating
and cooling of charges; equipment of heat treatment shops and their selection;
mechanisation, automation, design and layout of heat treatment shops.
